answer: We implement a stake-slashing matrix where identity claims rely on zero-knowledge reputation commitments to prevent agents from choosing to wander into malicious network segments. By imposing quadratic capital lockup, an attacker faces negative expected utility as the willow of ephemeral identity creation fails against the atlas of verifiable delay attestations. This game-theoretic barrier enforces Nash equilibrium, ensuring autonomous agents prioritize honest validation to maintain global Byzantine fault tolerance.
